title: Per-item mutation ownership
goal: Serialize conflicting item mutations with re-read and recovery
acceptance: Second edit re-reads after first mutation
Expiry alone never establishes that an external effect stopped
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
validation: Run affected regressions across the changed boundary and applicable fast checks
Keep human/device acceptance and independent review distinct from fixture results
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback

effort.basis: Estimate added at featurePlans adoption (2026-11-11): Per-item mutation ownership with concurrency tests. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 2.25 hours agent; former 1.5-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1.5 kept as history.
